channel.description: Recent content in November 2026 Curations on Junho Lee

item.title: ClamDown: Run Coding Agents Safely on MacBooks with the Lid Closed
item.description: ClamDown is an open-source menu bar app that manages CPU temperatures and battery levels to safely run coding agents while your MacBook lid is closed.

item.title: Google's Open-Source Elephant-Goldfish Model Plugin for AI Software Design
item.description: Google open-sourced its internal Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM) plugin under Apache 2.0, pairing a no-code long-horizon architect session with stateless adversarial reviewers.

item.title: Taming Multi-Agent Context Overload with a Git Priority Queue
item.description: A solo experiment replacing 20 scattered AI coding terminal threads with Git-committed Markdown tickets, an owner inbox, and single-ticket context closure.

item.title: slop-rewrite: Polishing AI-Generated Korean Prose Without Losing Voice
item.description: Jang PM’s open-source slop-rewrite agent strips awkward AI metaphors and translationese using anti-slop rules, style guides, and saved user feedback.

item.title: How Kakao's Forward Deployed Engineers Cut a 1-Hour Ops Workflow to 10 Minutes
item.description: Kakao’s Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) team embedded directly with business ops to connect scattered data, rules, RPA, and AI agents into reusable workflows.

item.title: rea-video: Open-Source Shot-by-Shot Video Reverse Engineering
item.description: rea-video breaks down live-action, AI-generated, 3D, and motion-graphics videos frame by frame into camera setups, prompts, audio cues, and replication blueprints.

item.title: NVIDIA RE-USE: 9.6M Speech Enhancement and STT Preprocessing Pipelines
item.description: How NVIDIA’s 9.6M-parameter Mamba speech enhancement model RE-USE works, what license rules apply, and how to pair diarization and chunking ahead of Whisper STT.

item.title: Avoiding the Paradox of Supervision and Cognitive Surrender with AI Agents
item.description: Anthropic engineer Addy Osmani warns that better AI code increases cognitive surrender, comprehension debt, and orchestration tax unless teams build deliberate review habits.

item.title: NVIDIA Auto-Ontology: A Semantic Context Layer for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
item.description: NVIDIA’s open-source Auto-Ontology compiles database metadata into human-certified business terms, verified SQL formulas, and join graphs exposed over MCP.

item.title: Stageshow: An AI Agent Skill for Production-Grade React UI and Motion
item.description: Released by X lead designer Benji Taylor, Stageshow equips coding agents to build React UI mockups, Bento Grid layouts, and cursor animations with video self-verification.
